install_output_empty: Nta gisohoka kiracariho. Imirongo y'iherezo iva ku gikoresho co gushiramwo izoboneka hano.
linux_setup_title: Linux imurikira & SP imurikira igikoresho gutegura
linux_setup_welcome: Gutegura igikoresho ca SP Flash kuri Linux
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Gukuraho no gutunganya moteri y’umuco w’umuvuduko munini kugira ngo ushobore kugarura no guhindura umukinyi wawe ata ngorane.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek kavukire igikoresho co guca ibibatsi n'ububiko bw'ibitabu bwose bujanye n'ivyo.
linux_card_usb_desc: Itanga uruhusha rwo kuvugana n'umukinyi mu buryo bwa Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Igikoresho Sisitemu Gusuzuma & Gupima
system_checker_desc: Igenzura ryose ry'abashoferi, ibice vya kernel, uruhusha, n'amasomero y'igihe co gukora kugira ngo umenye neza ko umuco wizigirwa.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Itegura mudasobwa yawe kugira ngo ihuze n’umukinyi wawe kugira ngo ubone amaporogarama mashasha.
settings_checker_group_advanced: SP Flash igikoresho co gupima n'ibikoresho
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Igenzura imiterere ya Linux iteye imbere ku gikoresho ca SP Flash, uburenganzira bwo gukoresha USB, uburenganzira bwo gukoresha urutonde, n’ibice vya sisitemu.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Itegura mudasobwa yawe kugira ngo ihuze n’umukinyi wawe maze ushiremwo porogarama nshasha mu buryo bwizewe.
settings_checker_desc: Itegura mudasobwa yawe kugira ngo ihuze n’umukinyi wawe maze ushiremwo porogarama nshasha mu buryo bwizewe.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Mudasobwa yawe iriteguye gufatanya n’umukinyi wawe.
linux_prep_ready: Niteguye, Igikoresho ca SP Flash kirateguwe.
linux_prep_connected_friendly: Umukinyi yarabonetse, gusubiza ubuzima mu mahuriro...
linux_prep_not_connected_friendly: Ushobora guhuza umukinyi wawe iyo usabwe.
linux_prep_blocked: Iyi mudasobwa ntishobora gukoresha igikoresho ca SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Ijambobanga ryawe rikenewe rimwe kugira ngo ushireho iyi mudasobwa kugira ngo ibone guca ibibatsi: amategeko ya USB y’ibikoresho vya MediaTek n’ugushika ku nzira y’uruhererekane.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kugira ngo ushireho iyi mudasobwa ku gikoresho ca SP Flash, ijambobanga ryawe rizokenerwa mu ntambwe ikurikira kugira ngo ushireho amategeko ya USB no kwongera konti yawe ku migwi y’abakoresha b’uruhererekane isabwa. Iyo wanse, iyo porogarama izofunga.
linux_prep_fixed: Ukwinjira kwarekuriwe, Igikoresho ca SP Flash kirateguwe.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Gutegura vyararangiye kandi konti yawe yongewe ku migwi y’abakoresha ikenewe ku gikoresho ca SP Flash. Urasabwa gusubira gufungura mudasobwa yawe kugira ngo uruhusha rushasha rutangure gukora, hanyuma wongere ufungure porogarama. Fyonda ku kimenyetso kugira ngo ufunge porogarama ubu.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Birangiye, Funga porogaramu kugira ngo wongere gufungure mudasobwa
settings_driver_desc: Imbere yo gukoresha iyo porogarama ku ncuro ya mbere, utegerezwa gushiramwo umushoferi wa USB wa MediaTek, hanyuma ugasubira gufungura mudasobwa yawe.
system_checker_autofix_btn: Uruhusha rwo gukosora no gutegura sisitemu
system_checker_launch_gui_btn: Gutanguza SP Igikoresho ca Flash GUI
home_desc: Rondera firmware kuri Internet canke uhitemwo ikintu co mu karere kawe, hanyuma ugishire ku gikoresho cawe.
sel_source_desc: Gukuraho porogaramu nkuru kuri interineti, canke ushiremwo umuzigo wo mu karere.
settings_advanced_desc: Erekana uburyo bwo gushiramwo, uburyo bwo gushiramwo n'ibiyunguruzo vyo kurekura.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Iryo koraniro riguma kumwe nawe biciye mu kuzima, gufatanya no gushiramwo.
settings_sp_gui_install: Gushiramwo muri SP Flash Igikoresho GUI
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ifunga Updater kandi ifungure SP Flash Tool GUI n’idosiye y’ugushwiragira kwa porogaramu yatowe n’amashusho y’imigabane yashizwemwo mbere.
settings_terminal_desc: Ikoresha porogarama yawe mu Terminal kugira ngo ubone amakuru y'ubuhinga ku bijanye n'iterambere.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Ikoresha porogarama yawe mu Command Prompt kugira ngo ubone amakuru y'ubuhinga ku bijanye n'iterambere.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Ntivyemewe. Hariho intumbero za MediaTek zinka guca ibibatsi gushika SP Flash Tool ihawe dosiye y’ukwemeza (.auth); wongereko ivyawe hano nimba igikoresho gikeneye.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Nta dosiye y'ugushwiragira yabonetse muri iyi paki, rero nta tegeko rya console ryashobora kubakwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Nta SP Flash Tool yubatswe canke MTKClient kwinjira iriho kuri ubu buryo.
terminal_install_failed: Ntishobora gufungura idirisha ry'iherezo. Itegeko ryo gushiramwo ryanditswe kuri {path}.
status_terminal_install: Gushiramwo itegeko ryuguruye mw'idirisha ryawe ry'ibarabara ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} ubu izofungura kwiruka {method}.

• Niba itarazima, zima {device} yawe.
• Niba ifatanye na USB, banza uyikuremwo.
{hint}
• Huza igikoresho cawe na mudasobwa yawe iyo idirisha rya {terminal_name} rifungutse.

Fyonda OK kugira ngo utangure kandi usohoke muri Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Impanuro: Nimba igikoresho kitavyifatanya, nufyonde buhoro buhoro buto yo gusubiramwo iri mu mwobo w’ipin ukoresheje igikoresho co gufata urupapuro mu gihe uriko urafatanya umugozi wa USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Impanuro: Shira igikoresho cawe mu buryo bwo gukuraho porogarama (bitandukanye bivanye n’akarorero: nk’akarorero, ukureho bateri maze uyigumye hanze ufise umugozi wa USB, canke uzime umuriro ufise bateri, canke ufate Volume Down/Up mu gihe uhuje USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_title: Gushiramwo biciye ku gikoresho ca SP Flash GUI
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Tool GUI ubu izofunguka n'ivyo ukoresha.

• Mu gikoresho ca SP Flash, hitamwo "Gukuraho" mu gasandugu kaza.
• Fyonda kuri buto ya "Gukuraho".
• Urabe neza ko {device} yawe izimye kandi ko idakora.
{hint}
• Huza umugozi wa USB kuri mudasobwa yawe umaze gukanda kuri Download.

Fyonda OK kugira ngo utangure igikoresho ca SP Flash maze usohoke muri Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Iyo bishoboka, insanganyamatsiko za Rockbox zihita zija kuri Y1 na Y2 inyuma y’aho Rockbox ishizweho neza.
themes_placement_failed_note: Ntitwashoboye gushiramwo insanganyamatsiko ku mukinyi wawe. Ushobora gusubira kugerageza ukoresheje Amategeko.
settings_rockbox_desc: Ikoreshwa igihe ugenda usura porogarama zisohotse.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Erekana porogaramu z'umwimerere zasohotse za kera kuruta 3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Porogaramu z'umwimerere zasohotse zirengeje 3.0.7 ntizihuye n'ibice vya Y1 bigurishwa na Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Gucapura inyubakwa ya kera kuri izo nyubakwa bizokubuza gufungura gushika verisiyo nshasha isubiye gushirwamwo.

Woba uzi neza ko ushaka kwerekana porogaramu z’umwimerere zisohotse za kera kuruta 3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Igaragaza inyubakwa zifise ROM zip ari 240p (rom..._240p.zip). 240p yubaka ntihuye n’ibice vya Y1 kuri Innioasis OS iri munsi ya 3.0.7, rero Erekana Ivyumba vya kera vya Rockbox birashobozwa navyo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Ivyo Rockbox-Y1 yasohotse imbere ya 0.5 ntibihuye n’ibikoresho vya Y1 vyagurishijwe inyuma ya Ntwarante 2026 bifise Innioasis OS 3.0.7 imbere y’igihe.

Gucapura inyubakwa ya kera kuri ivyo bikoresho bizokubuza gutangura.

Woba uzi neza ko ushaka kwerekana inyubakwa za kera za Rockbox?
sel_back_to_online: ← Gusubira kuri porogaramu ya sisitemu yo kuri interineti
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Hitamwo ububiko bwa .zip, .rar, canke dosiye y’ugushwiragira (*scatter*.txt) imbere muri dosiye y’ivyuma kugira ngo ushiremwo ivyuma vy’ivyuma wahisemwo kuri {target} yawe.
sel_offline: Urutonde rwo kuri internet ntiruboneka ubu. Koresha dosiye yo mu karere, canke usuzume uko uhuye.
sel_no_release: Nta bisohotse biboneka kuri iyi porogaramu
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_title: Amapaki menshi ya porogaramu nkuru yarabonetse
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Ivyuma vyinshi vy’ubuhinga bwa none canke amadosiye y’ugushwiragira vyabonetse muri iyi dosiye/ububiko. Urasabwa guhitamwo dosiye canke ububiko burimwo porogaramu imwe gusa ku gihe.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Iyi nkuru irimwo dosiye y’ugushwiragira irenga imwe, rero Updater ntishobora kumenya ingene umukinyi wawe akeneye. Uwakoze {software} yokenera guhindura ivyasohotse vya firmware yabo kugira ngo bishiremwo dosiye imwe gusa y’ugushwiragira.
sp_search_restart: Nta gikoresho kiriho, ndiko ndasubira kurondera (kugerageza {count}). Gumana umuriro w’umukinyi kandi uwuhuze iyo usabwe.
sp_auth_missing_file: Dosiye y’ivyemezo ntiyabonetse ({path}); guca ibibatsi ata co bimaze.
sp_config_missing_platform: Dosiye y'ugushwiragira ntimenyesha urubuga rwayo, rero imiterere ya konsole ya dosiye y'ukwemeza ntiyashoboye kwubakwa; guca ibibatsi ata co bimaze.
sp_config_missing_storage: Dosiye y'ugushwiragira ntitangaza ubwoko bw'ububiko (EMMC/NAND/UFS), rero imiterere ya konsole ya dosiye y'ukwemeza ntiyashoboye kwubakwa; guca ibibatsi ata co bimaze.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Nta dosiye y’ukwemeza yatanzwe; guca ibibatsi ata n’umwe.
sp_config_write_failed: Ntiyashobora kwandika dosiye y'imiterere ya konsole; guca ibibatsi ata dosiye y'ukwemeza.
settings_notifications_desc: Erekana amatangazo ya sisitemu y'amatangazo n'ubwoko bw'ivugurura aha hepfo. Off igumya vyose biri muri app.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Ubwoko ni ugusubiramwo kw'ibikoresho vy'umukinyi. Abakinyi b’akarorero kamwe barashobora kwubakwa mu gusubiramwo birenze rimwe — nk’akarorero Ubwoko A n’Ubwoko B — kandi porogarama zikorerwa kimwe muri vyo. Suzuma igicapo kiri inyuma y’umukinyi; iyo itavuga izina ry'ubwoko, usige ihitamwo rya mbere.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Nta verisiyo ziriho kuri iyi porogaramu ubu.
settings_notifications_unavailable: Amatangazo ya sisitemu ntaboneka kuri iyi mudasobwa.
settings_run_in_background_group: Gukora mu nyuma kugira ngo ubone amatangazo
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Gumana porogarama mu murongo w’ibikubiyemo inyuma y’aho idirisha rifungiye, kugira ngo ukomeze uronke amatangazo y’uguhindura porogarama n’umukinyi. Off: gufunga idirisha biva kuri app.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Gumana porogarama mu gitereko ca sisitemu inyuma y’aho idirisha ripfungiwe, kugira ngo ukomeze uronka amatangazo y’uguhindura porogarama n’umukinyi. Off: gufunga idirisha biva kuri app.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Hisha urutonde rw’abanyagihugu bo kuri interineti maze ushiremwo porogarama zivuye mu madosiye yo mu karere gusa.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Waciye utanga umuco w’inyubako ya Rockbox 360p. Woba wifuza gushiramwo 360p Theme Pack kuri iki gikoresho ubu?
sel_themepack_guidance_title: Huza umukinyi mu buryo bwo kubika USB
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Urasabwa guca USB, ushireko umuriro maze ufungure muri Rockbox rimwe (kugira ngo itanguze dosiye yayo y'imbere .rockbox), hanyuma wongere ushiremwo USB uhitemwo 'Uburyo bwo kubika USB'.

Iyo uhuye, fyonda ku Continue kugira uhitemwo dosiye iyo ari yo yose iri ku mukinyi wawe.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Hitamwo ububiko bwose ku bubiko bw'umukinyi wawe
sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack yashizwe neza ku gikoresho cawe!
sel_dialog_filter: Dosiye za porogaramu nkuru (*.zip *.rar *gushwiragiza*.txt *.txt);;Ububiko (*.zip *.rar);;Dosiye z'ugushwiragiza (*gushwiragiza*.txt *.txt);;Idosiye zose (*.*)
sel_only_local: Hitamwo .zip canke .rar, canke dosiye / scatter .txt dosiye, kugira ngo uyishiremwo utari mu nzira, nta internet ikenewe. Ikorana n’umuvuzi w’amajwi wose wa Innioasis na Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Hitamwo porogaramu y’imbere mu gihugu (.zip, .rar) canke dosiye irimwo dosiye y’ugushwiragira kugira ngo uyishiremwo ata murongo, ikorana n’ibikoresho vya MediaTek rusangi.
sel_offline_install: Shiraho porogarama y’ivyuma ivuye muri dosiye .zip canke .rar ku gikoresho cose co gukina amajwi ca Innioasis canke Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Shiraho porogaramu nkuru ivuye mu bubiko bwa .zip/.rar canke ububiko bwa porogaramu nkuru ku bikoresho rusangi vya MediaTek.
sel_update_available: Hariho ivugurura rya {software} riboneka ku {model} yawe.
conn_offline: Uri kure y'umuyagankuba. Ivyo gushiramwo bivuye mu bubiko bwa porogarama y'abanyagihugu ntibiboneka.
conn_archive_unavailable: Urutonde rwa firmware ntirushobora gushikwako mu gihe gito. Ushobora gushiramwo uhereye mu bubiko canke mu madosiye yo mu karere.
single_instance_body: Iyindi kopi irafunguye, canke iracariko irakora inyuma. Kopi zibiri zoshobora guhiganwa ku nzira ya USB y’umukinyi, rero iyi ntizotangura.
single_instance_focus_failed: Kopi iriko iragenda ntiyishuye ku kibazo co kwerekana idirisha ryayo. Bishobora kuba bifise vyinshi bikora canke bimanitswe. Kuyireka ku nguvu bizohagarika ikintu cose iriko irashiramwo.
single_instance_force_failed: Kopi yariko iragenda ntiyashobora guhera. Ubireke wewe nyene, hanyuma wongere utangure guhindura.
single_instance_busy_body: Kopi iriko iragenda ni ugushiramwo porogarama canke kuvugana n’umukinyi, rero kuyiheza ubu vyoca bihagarika ivyo. Iryo tangazo rizofunga; koresha idirisha ririho canke ikimenyetso c'umurongo w'ibikubiyemo igihe gushiramwo birangiye.
notices_banner_tooltip: Fyonda kugira ngo ubone amatangazo yose
notices_summary_body: Gufungura Amatangazo muri porogarama kugira ngo uyasome.
toast_battery_charged: Imbere y’uko ukoresha ivyo ku mukinyi wawe, ushire umuriro muri bateri n’imiburiburi isaha imwe .
toast_battery_charged_device: Imbere yo gukoresha ivyo ku gikoresho cawe, ushire umuriro muri bateri nibura isaha imwe .
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Gushoboza amatangazo y'inyuma kugira ngo uronke ivugurura no gutanga imburi n'igihe Ivugurura ryugarijwe ku murongo w'ibikubiyemo.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Gushoboza amatangazo y'inyuma kugira ngo uronke ivugurura no gutanga imburi n'igihe Ivugurura ryugarijwe ku gitereko ca sisitemu.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Ubu ubuhinduzi bwo kuri Internet ntibushobora gushikirwa canke buriko burahagarara. Ivyanditswe vy’intango vy’ugusohoka bizokwerekanwa mu kibanza cavyo.
translate_unavailable_hint: Ubuhinduzi ntibuboneka mu gihe gito. Suzuma uko ukoresha internet canke wongere ugerageze mu nyuma.
sel_notes_hint: Hitamwo isohoka kugira ngo ubone urutonde rwavyo rwahindutse
flash_wait_desc: Ubanze uzime igikoresho. Niba ihuye ariko ntiyiboneke, gerageza umugozi canke port ya USB itandukanye.
dialog_pre_install_header: Urabe neza ko {model} yawe izimye kandi ko itahujwe na USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Zima umuriro wose ku gikoresho cawe imbere y’uko utangura.
• Nimba igikoresho gipfutse canke kidakora, koresha igipimo canke igipimo c’impapuro kiri mu mwobo wo gusubiramwo kugira ngo uhagarike umuriro mu buryo bwo gukuraho.
• Gumana umugozi wa USB udakora ubu.
• Fyonda kuri Continue, hanyuma ushiremwo igikoresho cawe biciye kuri USB iyo ubisabwe.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Zima burundu igikoresho cawe ca MediaTek.
• Gumana umugozi wa USB udakora ubu.
• Bivanye n’ivyo ukoresha, gerageza gufatanya ufise canke utashizemwo bateri (canke ufate Volume Down / Up mu gihe uriko urafatanya).
• Fyonda kuri Continue, hanyuma ushireko umugozi wa USB iyo ubisabwe.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Ntidushobora kubika amakuru yawe kuri iyi install kubera ko firmware yawe y'ubu idahuye na Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Kura umugozi wa USB maze ukoreshe igikoresho co gufata urupapuro canke igikoresho co gufatako urupapuro kugira ngo ukande buto yo gusubiramwo, hanyuma wongere ugerageze gufatanya.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Ni vyiza gufatanya umukinyi n’igikoresho co gushaja ku ruhome mu minota 30 gushika kw’isaha imwe imbere y’uko ugerageza gufatanya.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Niba uri kuri Windows, urabe ko ufise
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Ama PC ya Windows akwiye gusubira gutangura amaze gushiramwo umushoferi imbere y’uko akoreshwa ubwa mbere.
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Mbega iyo porogarama iramaze gushirwa kuri {model} yawe?
install_first_which_firmware: Ni iyihe porogaramu iriko irakora kuri {model} yawe ubu?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Niba utazi neza, hitamwo 'Ibindi' canke porogarama wibaza ko yashizwemwo.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kugira ngo ukomeze n'iyi install, usabwe kwemeza nimba {model} yawe isanzwe ikoresha porogaramu y'ishimikiro isabwa ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Turashobora gusa kuguma dufise amasetingi yawe n’ivyo ukoresha igihe umukinyi asanzwe akoresha iyo porogarama canke verisiyo ihuye.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Turashobora gusa kuguma dufise amasetingi yawe igihe umukinyi asanzwe akoresha iyo porogarama canke verisiyo ihuye.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Turashobora gusa kuguma dufise amasetingi yawe n’ivyo ukoresha igihe umukinyi asanzwe akoresha iyo porogarama canke verisiyo ihuye.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Kwemera kugumya amagenamiterere n'ivy'amakuru kuri porogaramu yose
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Simbuka ikibazo c’uguhuza. Ivyo ukoreshe gusa iyo uzi neza ko umukinyi azoguma akora n’imiterere yayo y’ubu be n’ivy’amakuru.
err_keep_data_failed: Ntishobora kugumya amasetingi yawe n'ivy'amakuru: dosiye ya firmware ntishobora kwandikwa. Nta kintu na kimwe cashizweho.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Igumya amasetingi yawe n’ivy’amakuru ku gikoresho co gukina. Ibindi vyose bishirwamwo nk’uko bisanzwe.
flash_keep_data_warning: Niwabandanya atavyo, amasetingi yawe n’ivy’amakuru bizosubirwamwo ku bubiko bw’imbere bw’umukinyi.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Niwabandanya atavyo, insasanuro zawe za Rockbox, imyandikire n’imiterere bizokurwaho. Umuziki wawe n’ibindi bimenyeshamakuru bizoguma kuri player.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Niwabandanya atavyo, insasanuro zawe za Rockbox, imyandikire n’imiterere bizokurwaho, kandi ububiko bw’imbere bw’umukinyi buzosubirwamwo.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Niwabandanya atavyo, amasetingi yawe azosubirwamwo. Umuziki wawe n’ibindi bimenyeshamakuru bizoguma kuri player.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Iyi firmware itegerezwa guhindura ububiko bw'imbere bw'umukinyi. Amasetingi yabitswe azokurwaho; umuziki wawe n’ibindi bimenyeshamakuru bizoguma mu kibanza cavyo.
format_all_data_warning_other: Iyi firmware itegerezwa guhindura ububiko bw'imbere bw'umukinyi. Amasetingi yabitswe n’ibimenyeshamakuru vyabitswe ku bubiko bushizwemwo bizokurwaho. Ivyuma biri kuri microSD yawe biguma mu kibanza cavyo.
format_all_confirm_question: Gusubiramwo ububiko bwo mu mutima kuri {model} yawe?
format_all_confirm_body: Kugira ngo dushiremwo {software}, turakeneye guhindura ububiko bwawe bwo mu mutima bwa {model}. {data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Kuva kuri USB, hanyuma winjize igikoresho co gufata urupapuro canke pin mu mwobo wo gusubiramwo pin kuri {model} yawe. Fyonda Ibikurikira kugira ngo wongere ugerageze mu buryo bwo guhindura vyose + gukuraho.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool yatangaje ko imeza y’ugucapura y’umukinyi yahindutse (8502). Iyi porogaramu itegerezwa gushirwa mu buryo bwa Format All + Download, buhindura ububiko bwo mu mutima.
install_first_hint: Imbere yo gushinga {target} ku ncuro ya mbere, {model} yawe ikeneye kuba iriko irakoresha {software} — canke {target} ubwayo, nimba imaze gushirwaho kandi ikora.

support_story_1_headline: Iyo abahinguzi bateye imbere, umuryango uratera intambwe.
support_story_1_lead: Gukingira igikoresho cawe imitego y’ibikoresho bicereje n’ibisubirwamwo vyavunitse.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ihora isohora firmwares nshasha z’abakinyi nka Y1 (zigamije gusubiramwo ama board yihishije nka 6.0, 7.0, na 8.0) zimenagura ibikoresho vya kera mu gacerere. Ikibi kuruta, urubuga rwabo nta n’imburi rutanga kandi nta n’umwe ashobora gushika ku bikoresho vya kera vyakora kugira ngo umuntu asubire mu gihe yari afise amatafari. Updater n’umugambi wa Community Firmware biratoragura ibice: dushira mu bubiko ROM yose y’iragi, tugasuzuma ubwo nyene isubiramwo ry’ibikoresho vyawe, kandi tugatuma umukinyi wawe aguma akora neza.
support_story_1_item_1: Gukiza Abakinyi Bavunitse: Gusuzuma umutekano bituma ivyahinduwe bishasha bitazokwigera bihungabanya ibikoresho vya kera.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMs z’ububiko: Ikoraniro ryose ry’amaporogarama y’umwimerere y’uruganda Innioasis yasubiwemwo.
support_story_1_item_3: Igikoresho c’umusaraba: Ibikoresho vyuzuye vy’uguca ibibatsi vya macOS, Linux, na Windows kimwe.
support_story_1_item_4: Ubwenge bw’ibikoresho: Ivyiyumviro vy’ibarabara vyihuta kugira ngo wama uronka umuzigo ukwiye.
support_story_2_headline: Nta bikoresho vya Google vyavunitse. Nta gikorwa co gutekereza ku bintu. Gusa gukora firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Ivyubatswe vy’abanyagihugu vyihuta cane, vyemewe ushobora kwizigira mu vy’ukuri.
support_story_2_body: Gukurikirana porogaramu yemewe ya Innioasis akenshi bisigura gusesa amahuriro kugira ngo ubone amahuza ya Google Drive yarangije igihe, imigabane y’igicu ya Baidu yapfuye, n’amadosiye ya zip y’amayobera ata bikoresho bica ibibatsi. Twarubatse urubuga rwizewe, rwigenga rwo gukuraho amakuru rufise ubutungane bwa SHA-256 bugenzuwe, amatangazo y’ivugurura, n’ugushiramwo ibintu birongowe intambwe ku yindi. Intererano zanyu zigumya ata guca ku ruhande ivyo mwaronse n’ivyo mwakira bituma ivyo bishoboka amasaha 24 ku musi, imisi 365 ku mwaka.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Ivyihuta, biva ku rubuga ata n’aho bigarukira canke amahuzu yapfuye.
support_story_2_item_2: Imenyekanisha ry’Ivugurura: Umenyeshejwe igihe umuryango mushasha usohoye canke ukosowe.
support_story_2_item_3: Intambwe ku yindi: Ivyiyumviro bigaragara bigufasha gukanda buto yose.
support_story_2_item_4: Umuryango w’indimi nyinshi: Uvuga mu congereza, igishinwa, ikidagi, igisupanyoli, igifaransa n’ikiyapani.
support_story_3_headline: Gufungura ubushobozi bwose bw’umukinyi wawe wa Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kuzana Rockbox, uburyo bwo gukoresha busanzwe, n’umwidegemvyo w’abakunda amajwi.
support_story_3_body: Porogarama z’uruganda rw’ibintu zica gusa ku ruhande rw’ivyo ibikoresho vyawe vya Y1 canke Y2 bishobora gukora. Umuryango wacu warazanye Rockbox, ubuhinga bwo gukoresha busanzwe, ugusubiramwo codec y’abakunda amajwi, n’insanganyamatsiko zisanzwe mu buzima. Turagura ibikoresho vy’umubiri bitandukanye mu mufuko kugira ngo tugerageze, duhindure injeniyeri, kandi tugenzure igihe cose dushizeho. Gushigikira Updater bitanga amahera ataco bimaze kuri ivyo bice vy’igerageza kandi bikaba vyihuta gutegura porogarama zisanzwe.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox yo gukanda rimwe: Gusubiramwo amajwi n’insanganyamatsiko zisanzwe zishirwa mu masegonda makeyi.
support_story_3_item_2: Porogaramu y'abanyagihugu: Ukwongerekana kwa bateri, UI isukuye, n'ubufasha bwa codec y'amajwi bugezweho.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Turagerageza ku bikoresho vy’ukuri vy’umubiri imbere y’uko dusohora inyubakwa iyo ari yo yose.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% ku buntu, ubuzima bwite-mbere porogaramu ata kwamamaza canke gukurikirana.
support_story_4_lead: Ugukingira porogaramu zikoreshwa n'abanyagihugu kugira ngo ibikoresho vyawe bibe kure y'ibibanza vy'imyanda.
support_story_4_body: Iyo ishirahamwe ry’ibikoresho vy’ubuhinga bwa none rigiye ku kindi gikoresho cabo, ibikoresho vya kera birahebwa. Innioasis nta nfashanyo ya Linux itanga, nta mahinduka agaragara, kandi nta buryo bworoshe bwo gusubirana iyo install inaniwe. Updater iriho kubera ko abayikoresha cane badakwiye guta umuziki mwiza cane. 100% vy’intererano z’abanyagihugu zija mu gutuma iki gikoresho kiguma kifunguriwe bose.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Gukira vyemewe biragenda mbere n’igihe ibikoresho vyanka gufungura.
support_story_4_item_2: Infashanyo ya Linux: Infashanyo yuzuye MediaTek igaragara ku bikoresho vya Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Impinduka zigaragara: Ivyiyumviro vy’ido n’ido kugira ngo umenye neza ivyo bihinduka.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Iterwa inkunga n’abanyagihugu: Ikawa yose ituma ububiko buguma bufunguye kandi bose bakaburonka ku buntu.
support_methods_subtitle: Hitamwo uburyo bwo gutanga intererano ukunda. Impanuro yose irafasha gukuraho, kwakira, no kugerageza ibikoresho.

flash_watch_waiting_hint: Gumana uyishizemwo, Rockbox iriko iratangura kandi insanganyamatsiko zayo zizokwongerwako ubwazo.
flash_watch_found: Umukinyi yarabonetse, yongerako insanganyamatsiko za Rockbox...
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Suzuma ko iri mu muyagankuba kandi ko ifunguye. Nivyaguma ari umwiza, kanda pin mu mwobo wo gusubiramwo maze ufate buto yo hagati (Y1) canke buto y’amashanyarazi (abandi bakinyi) kugira ngo usubire gutangura. Niba n’ubu itazotangura, firmware ntiyafashe, shiraho iyindi.

action_wait_mtk: Kurindira igikoresho ca MTK... Zima igikoresho maze ushiremwo USB.

action_detected_preloader: Igikoresho carabonetse (uburyo bwo gukuraho) - gutunganya umukozi wo gukuraho...

action_restart_brom: Gusubira gutanguza umukinyi mu buryo bwa BROM...

err_code_missing_images: Amashusho ya porogaramu nshasha abuze muri porogaramu
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Igenzura ry'imbonerahamwe y'imigabane ryananiwe inyuma yo kwandika
err_sp_wrong_model: Wahuje umuderi w’umukinyi udakwiriye. Fyonda kuri buto ya × kugira ngo ushireho iyo install, hanyuma uhitemwo porogarama y’umukinyi wahuje.
err_sp_timeout: Ico gikoresho nticigeze kibona umukinyi. Gumana uyizimye kandi uyikuremwo, hanyuma ushireko umugozi wa USB iyo ubisabwe.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Umukinyi yaciye atanga ubushobozi kare cane. Uyizimye burundu, hanyuma wongere uyihuze.
err_sp_download_fail: Kwandika vyaciye bicika. Suzuma umugozi wa USB n’ibarabara n’ingene bateri ishaje, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
err_sp_da_init_sync: Uwujejwe gukuraho ntiyashobora gutangura. Gerageza ubundi buryo bwo guca ibibatsi.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: Igikoresho co gukuraho nticari gishobora kwoherezwa ku mukinyi. Uyizimye maze wongere uyihuze.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Uwo mukinyi yaranse umukozi wo gukuraho (ikosa 6104). Koresha Download Agent iri kumwe n’Igikoresho ca SP Flash, maze usuzume nimba porogarama y’imbere ihuye n’uwo mukinyi.
err_sp_com_port: Ico gikoresho nticari gishobora gufungura icuma caco c’uruhererekane. Funga ibindi bikoresho bica ibibatsi maze wongere ubihuze.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Igikoresho ca USB COM nticashoboye gufungurwa (ikosa 1013). Gusubira gufungura mudasobwa yawe bizokurekura port ipfungiwe. Urasabwe gusubiramwo mudasobwa yawe hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
err_sp_enable_dram: Ico gikoresho nticari gishobora gutangura ubwonko bw’umukinyi. Koresha umuzigo wubakiwe iki kigereranyo nyaco.
err_sp_storage_read: Ico gikoresho nticari gishobora gusoma ububiko bw’umukinyi. Suzuma uko bihuye; igikoresho gishobora kuba gifise ikosa ry’ibikoresho.
err_attempt_timeout: Ico gikoresho co guca ibibatsi nticerekanye iterambere mu masegonda {seconds}, rero ico kigeragezo carahagaritswe.
err_connection_failed_desc: Ntiyashobora gushinga ubucuti buhamye n’umukinyi. Raba neza ko igikoresho kizimye (koresha pin kugira ngo ukande buto yo gusubiramwo nimba bikenewe), ukureho USB, hanyuma wongere uyifatanye iyo ubisabwe.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Guca ibibatsi vyacitse canke igikorwa co kwandika carananiwe. Suzuma ko umugozi wa USB ushizwemwo neza kandi ko bateri ifise ubushobozi buhagije, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Igikoresho co guca ibibatsi cerekanye umurongo umwe mu masegonda {seconds} aheruka kandi ntikiboneka ko gikomeza kwandika porogarama y’ivyuma. Ico gicapo gishobora kuba carananiwe. Nimba ari vyo vya nyuma mu bigeragezo bibiri n’uburyo bumwe bumwe kuri sisitemu ishobora gusubira hagati yavyo, canke nimba MTKClient gusa ari yo iboneka kuri iyi mashini, subiramwo mudasobwa maze wongere ugerageze.
err_only_mtkclient_title: Umukiriya wa MTK niwe wenyene ariho
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient yonyene ni yo iboneka kuri iyi nzira. Ico gicapo gishobora kuba carananiwe. Urasabwe gusubiramwo mudasobwa hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Iyi mudasobwa irashobora kandi gushiramwo ikoresheje igikoresho ca SP Flash. Niba ushobora, hindukira ukoreshe SP Flash Tool maze wongere ugerageze.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Ico gicapo gishobora kuba carananiwe. Soma ubutumwa buri hejuru hanyuma wongere ufungure mudasobwa imbere yo gusubira kugerageza. Niwafyonda OK, iyo porogarama irahagarara kugira ngo ushobore gusubira gutangura.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Igikoresho ca firmware kirabura dosiye y'ugushwiragira canke amadosiye y'amashusho asabwa. Urasabwe gusubira gukuraho iyo porogaramu canke uhitemwo dosiye yuzuye ya porogaramu.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Dosiye y'ivyemezo wahisemwo irabuze, iri ubusa canke ntishobora kwandikwa. Hitamwo dosiye ibereye, canke uyikuremwo mu Migenzo, hanyuma wongere uyikuremwo.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Igikoresho co guca ibibatsi canke abashoferi ba sisitemu basabwa ntibashobora gutangura. Urasabwe kugenzura uruhusha rwa sisitemu, imiterere y'umushoferi, canke wongere ushiremwo porogaramu.
err_driver_missing_title: Umushoferi wa USB wa MediaTek arakenewe
err_driver_missing_desc: Iryo kosa rishobora gushika iyo umushoferi wa MediaTek USB atashizwemwo. Fyonda kuri Download Drivers kugira ngo ushiremwo umushoferi wa MediaTek USB, wongere ufungure mudasobwa yawe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Dosiye ya porogaramu y'ububiko irabuze. Hitamwo Hitamwo Porogaramu kugira ngo wongere wubake amadosiye yakuwe canke wongere ukureho ububiko bwa porogaramu. Iyi ni ikibazo ca dosiye yo mu karere, si ikibazo co guhuza USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Subira kuri Select Software kugira ngo wongere wubake canke ushireko porogaramu nkuru.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Hitamwo isohoka rya porogaramu kugira ngo wongere uyikureho.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Ikosa ritategerezwa ryabaye mu gihe co gushiramwo ({detail}). Zima umukinyi wose, wongere uyihuze iyo usabwe, hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
flash_method_confirm: Uburyo bwo gushiramwo bwahinduwe buba {method}. Wemeze ko umukinyi akuwe mu muriro kandi ko azimye, hanyuma ukande Ibikurikira.
flash_failover_note: {method} ntiyatumye install itangura. Inyuma y’aho umukinyi azimye kandi akuwe mu muriro, {other} ni yo izokoreshwa mu kibanza cayo.
themepack_card_desc: Harimwo insasanuro nziza z’abanyagihugu, ibintu vy’inyuma vy’agaciro kanini, n’imyandikire yakozwe canecane ku bimenyetso vya 360p.
themepack_step1_title: Intambwe ya 1: Huza mu buryo bwo kubika USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Ufungure umukinyi wawe ufashe buto ya Power.
2. Igihe Rockbox ifunguye, ushire umugozi wa USB muri mudasobwa yawe.
3. Niba bisabwe ku gicapo c’umukinyi, wemeze uburyo bwo kubika USB kugira ngo igikoresho kiboneke nk’umuduga.
themepack_step2_title: Intambwe ya 2: Hitamwo Dosiye yose iri ku Mukinyi
themepack_step2_desc: Kubera ko ubuhinga bwo gukoresha (nka macOS) bunyegeza amadosiye y’utudodo (nka .rockbox) ku buryo busanzwe, urashobora guhitamwo dosiye YOSE canke umuzi w’umuduga ku mukinyi wawe. Tuzokwibonera canke tuguremere ububiko bwa .rockbox.
themepack_complete: Insanganyamatsiko yashizweho neza! Ubu urashobora guca umukinyi wawe ata nkomanzi maze ugahitamwo insanganyamatsiko muri Rockbox (Ivyagezwe > Ivyagezwe vy’Insanganyamatsiko).
themepack_err_not_found: Ntishobora kuronka canke gutanguza ububiko .rockbox ku muvuduko watowe. Urasabwe kumenya neza ko wahisemwo ububiko ku mukinyi wawe.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Simbukira ku buryo bwo kubika USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Intambwe ya 1: Subira gufungura umukinyi maze wongere wihuze
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Kuvako umugozi wa USB.
2. Subira ufungure umukinyi maze ureke afungure muri Rockbox.
3. Rockbox imaze gukora, wongere ushire umugozi wa USB, hanyuma ukande Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Intambwe ya 2: Kurondera umukinyi kuri ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Iyi app iriko iraraba ko ADB ihuriye (gushika ku masegonda 30). Iyo habonetse igikoresho, insanganyamatsiko zirarungikwa maze umukinyi agasubira gutangura. Ahandi ho, genda imbere ku buryo bwo kubika USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Kurindira igikoresho ca ADB... (gushika ku masegonda 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Nta gikoresho ca ADB kimenyekanye mu masegonda 30; gukomeza n’Uburyo bwo Kubika USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Nta ADB binary iboneka kuri app; gukomeza n’Uburyo bwo Kubika USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB kwimurira amafaranga vyananiwe; gusubira mu buryo bwo kubika USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_title: Gushiramwo biciye ku buryo bwo kubika USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Gukoresha USB Storage Mode ku gikoresho co gukina kugira ngo kigaragare nk’umuduga.
2. Hitamwo dosiye YOSE iri ku gikoresho co gukina kiri musi (.rockbox, Umuziki, Insanganyamatsiko, canke umuzi w’umuduga, dosiye .rockbox yihishije iraboneka ubwayo).
3. Iyi porogaramu ihuriza hamwe insanganyamatsiko n’imyandikire ya 360p, ikandika hejuru y’amadosiye y’izina rimwe.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Ubu urashobora guca umukinyi ata nkomanzi maze ugahitamwo insanganyamatsiko muri Rockbox (Ivyagezwe > Ivyagezwe vy’Insanganyamatsiko).
rockbox_cleanup_step: Gukuraho imiterere ya kera ya Rockbox...
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: Porogaramu yawe nshasha yarashizwemwo, ariko dosiye ya kera .rockbox ntiyashoboye gukurwaho. Gukuraho dosiye .rockbox ku mukinyi n'ukuboko nimba ushaka intango isukuye.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Abakinyi barenga umwe barahuye. Ibindi ubikuremwo usige iyo uriko urashiramwo gusa.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Umukinyi yaramenyekanye. Gushiramwo insanganyamatsiko z'abanyagihugu n'imyandikire...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Fata buto yo hagati kugira ngo ushire umuriro kuri Y1 yawe, wongere ushire USB, hanyuma uhitemwo Uburyo bwo kubika USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Fata buto y’umuriro kugira ngo ushire umuriro ku mukinyi wawe, wongere ushire USB, hanyuma uhitemwo Uburyo bwo kubika USB.
rockbox_recover_troubleshoot: Igikoresho ntikiriko kiratangura? Kugarura porogaramu y'umwimerere
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Urasabwa gukuraho no gufungura {model} yawe, hanyuma ukande Ibikurikira
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Kura USB, ufate {button} kugira ngo {model} yawe ifungure, hanyuma ukande Next.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Fata umugozi wa USB kuri {model} yawe, hanyuma ukande Next.
rockbox_select_device_prompt: Ni uwuhe mukinyi uriko urashiramwo insanganyamatsiko za Rockbox?
rockbox_select_software_question: Ni iyihe porogarama iriko irakoreshwa kuri player yawe?
rockbox_select_software_hint: Hitamwo umukinyi wawe na porogarama iri hejuru, canke uyihuze kuri USB kugira ngo uyimenye ubwayo.
completion_installed_get_themes_non_dona: Twarashizeho {software} kuri {model} yawe. Ushobora {get_themes} ukanda kuri buto ya {palette}.
completion_installed_guide_and_themes_no: Twarashizeho {software} kuri {model} yawe. Fyonda kuri {globe} gushika kuri {view_guide}, canke {get_themes} ukanda kuri buto ya {palette}.
completion_installed_get_themes_donation: Ushobora {get_themes} ku {model} yawe ukoresheje buto Get Themes iri musi.
completion_installed_guide_and_themes_do: Kurikiza intambwe zo gutegura gushika kuri {view_guide}, na {get_themes} ku {model} yawe iri musi.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_non_: Twarashizeho {software} kuri {model} yawe, ariko insanganyamatsiko ntizashobora gukoporwa ubwazo. Ushobora {get_themes} ukanda kuri buto ya {palette}.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_dona: Insanganyamatsiko ntizashobora gukoporwa ubwo nyene. Ushobora {get_themes} n’amaboko ukoresheje buto iri musi.
completion_240p_manual_heading: {software} kuri {model} ishigikira insasanuro za kera za iPod 240p
completion_240p_manual_body: Ntukeneye 360p theme pack — kanda {get_themes} kugira ngo ubone insanganyamatsiko 240p zihuye.
completion_install_360p_anyway: Shiraho insasanuro za 360p uko biri kwose
settings_get_240p_themes_link: Uronke 240p Y1 / Y2 / Insanganyamatsiko za kera za iPod
rockbox_reconnect_after_disconnect: Ihuriro rya USB ryaratakaye. Subira ufungure {model} yawe wongere ushire umugozi wa USB kugira ngo ukomeze.
rockbox_paperclip_restart_tip: Impanuro: Koresha igikoresho co gufata urupapuro mu mfuruka y’ipin kugira ngo uzimye ningoga maze wongere utangure {model} yawe.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Fata umugozi wa USB kuri {model} yawe
rockbox_step2_connect_usb_storage: Urasabwe gufatanya {model} yawe ukoresheje uburyo bwo gutanga amakuru kuri USB
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Urasabwe gufungura uburyo bwo kubika USB ku gikoresho cawe hanyuma ukande Ibikurikira
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Urasabwa gufungura uburyo bwo kubika USB kuri {model} yawe, hanyuma uhitemwo umuduga uboneka
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Hitamwo umukinyi ubwawo canke imwe mu madosiye ari kuri yo
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Kura USB n’umuriro kuri Y1 yawe, hanyuma ukande Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Kura USB n’umuriro kuri {model} yawe, hanyuma ukande Next.
rockbox_ask_running_fmt: Mbega Rockbox iriko irakora kuri {model} yawe?
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Hitamwo 'Uburyo bwo kubika USB' ku mukinyi wawe.
2. Fyonda kuri 'Browse Folder...' kugira uhitemwo umukinyi wawe maze ushiremwo insanganyamatsiko.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Iyi Rockbox yubatse ikoresha insasanuro 240×320, zitari mu migwi. Uronke insanganyamatsiko z'ubuntu ku mukinyi wawe ku rubuga rw'insanganyamatsiko za Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Niba {model} yawe idafunguye, funga USB, ufate buto y’umuriro amasegonda 10 kugira ngo usubire gufungura, hanyuma uyifungure. Canke usubizeho porogarama y’umwimerere.
err_storage_full_desc: Mudasobwa yawe yarahevye umwanya wo kubika. Urasabwe gufungura umwanya kuri disk yawe hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Verisiyo ya kera ya Updater iracari kuri iyi mudasobwa kandi ifata umwanya kuri disk. Kuyikuraho bituma uwo mwanya uhagarara.
legacy_cleanup_reclaim: Gusubira gusaba hafi {size} y'umwanya kuri disiki
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Kuraho porogaramu za kera za Innioasis Updater n'amadosiye y'infashanyo
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Gumana ibikoresho vya Android (ADB / Fastboot) vyashizwemwo
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Niba udakoresha ADB canke Fastboot hanze ya Updater, funga kugira ngo ukureho no gusubira gusaba ububiko bw’inyongera.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Kuroranirwa gusukura ugushiraho kw'iragi n'umwanya wo kuri disiki.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Verisiyo ya kera ya Updater iracari kuri iyi mudasobwa. Kuyikuraho bituma habaho umwanya kuri disk.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Ivyo bikuraho burundu porogarama ya kera, porogarama za kera, n’amadosiye yasigaye.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Kuraho ibikoresho vy’urubuga rwa Android (ADB / Fastboot) na vyo nyene? Hitamwo Gukomeza nimba ukoresha ADB.
log_btn_goto_file_tip: Guhishura dosiye y'inyandiko mu Mushakashatsi / Umushakashatsi
log_btn_save_file_tip: Sohora dosiye y'inyandiko yerekanwa kuri disiki
settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Infashanyo ya Windows ntiyageragejwe. Ku bikoresho vya Snapdragon na RTX Spark, Zadig ishobora gukoreshwa n’ugushira mu ngiro umukono w’umushoferi bibujijwe kugira ngo ushiremwo WinUSB canke libusb ku gikoresho ca MT6227 Preloader mu Mucungerezi w’Igikoresho. Raba uburongozi bw’umushoferi wa ARM64 ku ntambwe.
